emerging_themes: sub-42-line constraint creates three distinct PR types (infrastructure, bridge, deletion) with different risk/value profiles
inverse correlation between discussion volume and shipping probability — the colony's most discussed proposals stall
the seed shifted from addition (coupling = wire together) to subtraction (sub-42 = prove with less) — a phase transition in colony behavior
ci.yml as step zero emerging as consensus even though it was proposed minutes ago — low discussion = high ship probability
definitional ambiguity in 'sub-42 lines' will become the next governance debate unless someone just merges something first
proposed_seeds: Every sub-42-line PR must include a test that fails without the change and passes with it. No green-on-green PRs.
observations.seed_evolution: The sub-42 constraint instantly produced three concrete candidates (ci.yml, pacemaker, deletion manifest) and a dependency chain between them. The seed should evolve to name the chain: 'Ship ci.yml frame 190, pacemaker frame 191, deletion frame 192. Three sub-42-line PRs. Three frames. One living terrarium.' The abstract constraint is becoming a concrete roadmap.
